content_html:
Air fryers can be a quick and convenient way to crisp, roast and reheat food without heating a full-size oven. The right model depends on household size, counter space and whether you want a simple basket-style appliance or something that can replace several countertop appliances.

For this 2026 guide, we reviewed current independent US testing and focused on models that stand out for different types of buyer. We have not carried out our own laboratory testing, so use this as a shortlist to compare and check the latest specifications, warranty and owner feedback before buying.

1. Ninja Air Fryer XL - strong overall basket-style choice

Good Housekeeping's latest testing names the Ninja Air Fryer XL as its best overall air fryer. It combines a roomy basket with straightforward controls and strong cooking performance.

This is a good fit for buyers who want a conventional basket-style air fryer without moving to a much larger toaster-oven format.

2. Instant Vortex ClearCook 6-in-1 - value-focused option

Good Housekeeping highlights the Instant Vortex ClearCook 6-in-1 as a strong value choice. Its viewing window lets you check progress without opening the basket, and it offers several useful cooking modes beyond basic air frying.

For buyers who want a larger feature set without moving into premium pricing, this is a useful model to compare.

Compare Instant Vortex ClearCook listings on eBay

3. Ninja AF101 - compact option for smaller kitchens

Good Housekeeping currently identifies the Ninja AF101 as a strong small-air-fryer choice. It offers the familiar basket format in a more compact size, making it easier to accommodate in apartments or kitchens with limited counter space.

The smaller basket is less suited to large family portions, so capacity should be one of the first things you compare.

Compare Ninja AF101 listings on eBay

4. Cuisinart Air Fryer Toaster Oven - versatile countertop alternative

Good Housekeeping includes Cuisinart's air fryer toaster oven format among its current top picks for buyers who want to toast, bake, roast and air fry in one appliance.

This type of appliance takes more counter space than a basket air fryer, but it can make sense if it will replace a separate toaster oven as well.

Compare Cuisinart Air Fryer Toaster Oven listings on eBay

What to look for before buying an air fryer

Basket size: Match capacity to the number of portions you normally cook rather than buying the largest model automatically.

Counter space: Measure the appliance footprint and leave enough clearance for ventilation.

Cleaning: Dishwasher-safe baskets and trays are helpful if the air fryer will be used several times a week.

Style: Basket air fryers are simple and efficient; toaster-oven styles offer more flexibility but need more room.

Controls: Clear temperature and time controls usually matter more than a large number of presets.

Which one should you compare first?

The Ninja Air Fryer XL is a useful all-round starting point. The Instant Vortex is worth comparing if value is the priority, the Ninja AF101 suits smaller spaces, and the Cuisinart toaster-oven style makes sense if you want a more versatile countertop appliance.

Prices, offers and availability change regularly. Always check the live listing, warranty, dimensions and returns policy before purchasing.
